Use one intact neutral alert pose, facing RIGHT, with clearly readable silhouette, grounded supports aligned to an imaginary horizontal line. Detailed painterly biomechanical game illustration matching the supplied reference, not a generic redesign.

No scene, floor or cast shadow. Preserve original palette under limited blue-grey frost microtexture rather than repainting the whole subject white.
Original authored project variant; not a new official species, canon-exact certification or animation.
